responsibility: Implements the root memory facade used by the imported D front end. `Mem` wraps allocation, duplication, reallocation, and free operations with fatal out-of-memory handling, and also provides the arena-style `allocmemory` helper used for never-freed compiler data structures and generated strings.
same_name_distinction: This source file provides the concrete memory routines, the global mem instance, and the never-freed allocmemory arena allocator. Unlike the corresponding header in the same stem group, it is where allocation behavior and out-of-memory handling are implemented.
